public_metadata_used_before_freeze: site IDs assigned at first occupation and mapped for consistent monitoring
published sequence includes increase, decline and recovery

question: Do previously used common-guillemot breeding sites require a higher surrounding sub-colony population state for later reoccupation than the state associated with their earlier transition to vacancy?

standardized_input_contract.occupied_definition: 1 if the breeding site was occupied for breeding in that year; 0 only if the source data or supporting documentation establishes that the site was monitored/eligible and not occupied; missing otherwise
standardized_input_contract.subcolony_size_definition: number of occupied breeding sites in the focal sub-colony and year, using the source definition
standardized_input_contract.adapter_rule: Raw-column names may be mapped to these semantic fields after freeze. No ecological filter, threshold, vacancy definition, year selection or outcome-dependent recoding may be introduced by the adapter.
standardized_input_contract.missingness_stop_rule: If an absent site-year row cannot be distinguished from a monitored unoccupied site-year, the primary test is not identifiable and must stop.

eligibility.completed_spell: 1 -> 0 ... 0 -> 1 with at least one full vacant year and all intervening site states observed

aggregation: mean H across repeated spells within site_id
equal-weight mean across the five subcolonies
estimand.primary_statistic: T_obs = mean of five subcolony mean H values

confirmatory_inference.condition_2: exact one-sided sign-flip across the five subcolony contributions, p <= 0.05

shift_null.grouping: subcolony x identical calendar-consecutive state-complete block
shift_null.rule: draw one non-circular integer offset from the precomputed common-offset intersection and apply it to every spell in that group; preserve observed surrounding-state trajectories; no wrapping

secondary_sensitivity.name: two_year_vacancy
secondary_sensitivity.definition: repeat the frozen estimand using only spells with at least two consecutive vacant years
secondary_sensitivity.role: interpretive sensitivity only; cannot rescue a failed primary test

interpretation.allowed_if_supported: Previously used breeding sites were reoccupied at higher surrounding sub-colony population states than those associated with their earlier transition to vacancy, beyond generic temporal alignment with the observed sub-colony trajectory.
interpretation.allowed_program_level: Numerical recovery need not retrace prior breeding-site loss.
forbidden: individual birds required a higher threshold to return
annual vacancy is equivalent to permanent abandonment

stop_rule: After raw outcome values are opened, do not change the support thresholds, vacancy definition, aggregation, transform, null, sign-flip unit, missingness rule, or add phase-specific/subcolony-specific rescue analyses.
